text: The Dubai warehouse cost centre was renamed on 1 September. Pick DXB-WH-02; the old code DXB-07 no longer accepts new purchase orders.

citations.quote: From 1 September the Dubai warehouse cost centre is DXB-WH-02. The old code DXB-07 no longer accepts new purchase orders.

text: Approved POs release to the supplier automatically, so you shouldn't need to call finance. If a PO shows Pending release for more than a day, open it and choose Request release.

citations.quote: Once every approver has signed off in Ariba, the purchase order is released to the supplier automatically. Buyers do not need to contact Finance to release an approved PO.
If an approved PO shows Pending release for more than one working day, open it and choose Request release. The request goes to the Procurement team, not to Finance.

text: In Ariba, open Purchase Orders, then My Requests. The Status column shows who holds the approval and since when.
